acceptance.deterministic: Preflight and reopen pass, exact pre-write and persisted counts/times/source IDs, no absent-row creation, unchanged fact fields.
acceptance.performance: Median combined isolated wall / median legacy write wall <= 0.50 in both AB and BA strata for 8192 keys. Publish cold-first and low-key observations separately.
acceptance.scope: One test-only temporary schema comparison. No production deployment, migration, model, full-history retest, or inferred end-to-end gain.

arms.first_access: Separately timed existence and create-or-increment transaction; verification and reset outside timer.
arms.isolated: Awaited exact-key side-record projection then narrow UPDATE on existing side record.
arms.legacy: Existing production writer, awaited single UPDATE on fact returning NONE.

build_command: CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_OPT_LEVEL=3 cargo test -p memory_mcp --features eval-support --test fact_access_payload --no-run --locked --message-format=json
engine: SurrealDB 4.0.1 embedded SurrealKV on native Darwin arm64
failure_policy: Stop on deterministic runtime fault or external cap, retain all observed phase rows and raw log, do not replace a failed attempt.
fixed_order: 1-key then 8192-key. Pairs 0..19; legacy/isolated for even pairs, isolated/legacy for odd pairs. First access follows each pair.
metrics: Arm wall-clock and combined DB-call microseconds; logical queries and API-boundary SQL+JSON requests/JSON responses, not engine byte counters.
runtime_retry_policy: Existing SurrealDbClient only. No test-run retries.
